title: bodycount-2012-warrior-grand-prix-championship
label: Viktor Reise

won.source: BodyCount's own results column for the Warrior Grand Prix final, posted 21 October 2012: Reise knocked out Jakob Alexander in the second round to become, in the fed's own words, the first ever Warrior Grand Prix champion.

note: No further defense or title change survives in the held record; a second Warrior Grand Prix was announced in May 2015 but never reached a result.
